# avxcloud Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Aviatrix Cloud API access key.

### Optional

- `addr` (String) The API address of the Aviatrix controller. Defaults to https://api.cloud.aviatrix.com.
- `insecure_tls` (Boolean) Disable TLS verification
